correctness.rationale: The proof gives necessary and sufficient zero-protection and positive-support criteria for each bipartition side, partitions all labelings by whether each side has 0, 1, or at least 2 label-2 vertices, and counts all resulting cases without overlap. value.rationale: The crown graph is a canonical matching-deletion perturbation of a complete bipartite graph, and total Roman feasibility reacts sharply to exactly those missing paired edges. The theorem classifies every feasible labeling and gives the full weight distribution, not merely a recomputed minimum. The resulting minimum jump from 4 in the complete-bipartite comparison to 6 and the exact optimum multiplicity are natural consequences of the structural formula.
